fields.statement: Which intent should change set 01M6M2R7 (duplicate agent actor records) serve? m4-runs-hold-up says runs finish 'with no swept-up actor records', and the earlier actor-record fix 01M602TH serves milestone-4. / How should a session's actor record stop being duplicated? Cause found in the code: session start (recordAgentActor, internal/api/session.go:668) writes the record only in the run worktree. A verifier works in its own checkout (dir), which lacks the record, so the agent hand-adds `add actor <handle> --record` there, and both get committed.
